_published_faq.name: How do I add Evaneos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Evaneos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://chatgpt-app.evaneos.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Evaneos MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Evaneos scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Evaneos MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evaneos provides these MCP tools: suggest_destinations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Evaneos?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Evaneos in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Evaneos does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Evaneos is developed by Evaneos. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
